desc:
Wheelie. Send it. Repeat. 🏍️💨

Grab a dirt bike and tear through mountain trails, forests and big jumps! Every wheelie and every second in the air earns you cash. Race the checkpoint course to the finish, or cruise around in free roam. Unlock faster bikes, tune them your way, and see how far you can push it before you wipe out. 💥

Ride hard, crash harder, and become the ultimate dirt bike legend! 🏆
